author: Haruko
name: BattleMetric
short: BattleMetrics, HLL RCON, stats, territory protection, VIP, and dog-tag review cog.
description: Modular Redbot cog for BattleMetrics server data, HLL: Vietnam kill feeds, seeding and HQ protection, timed VIPs and VIP team switching, PostgreSQL statistics, account linking, and custom dog-tag review.
install_msg: BattleMetric loaded. Use [p]help battlemetric, [p]help serverinfo, [p]help killfeed, [p]help dogtag, /link, /vnstat, or /hllvn.
end_user_data_statement: Reads BattleMetrics, HLL RCON, PostgreSQL, and tagweb IPC secrets from Red's shared API-token storage; stores settings, authorized Discord user IDs, seeding and HQ-protection settings, the VIP team-swap toggle, timed VIP records, and pending dog-tag review metadata; stores account links and HLL statistics in PostgreSQL; and stores staged or approved dog-tag PNGs in the configured host directory.
